name: ldvh
description: Thin Codex SessionStart adapter for the LDVH Helper CLI

interface.shortDescription: Loads LDVH governance context when a Codex task starts.
interface.longDescription: A thin SessionStart adapter that sends the current Codex work object to the configured LDVH Helper and returns its mechanical result to the AI.
defaultPrompt: Show the LDVH governance context for this task.
